name: vodmal
description: AI-powered plugins for development tools by Dmitry Vorobyev.

plugins.name: vdm
plugins.description: SDLC workflow plugins: docs-sync (documentation synchronization), docs-distill (synthesis layer — the summary view nobody rebuilds because nobody asks; discovery + drift signal via `covers:` frontmatter, crystal harvest on cut, two-way handoff with docs-sync), learn (knowledge capture), changelog (project change tracking), crystal-* (multi-root workitem discipline gate — grow/bud/cut/cave/migrate with auto-scan + 4-tier status taxonomy + in-flight capture-reminder + orphan-sidetracks gate + batch legacy-doc migration + evidence discipline: Basis taxonomy, pre-action gate, live current-model section), intercom (central cross-agent/cross-session message store outside all repos, git-remote-identity routing + agent directory: auto-aliases + user-said names + description, SessionStart identity check, hard-stop on unresolved targets).

plugins.name: vdm-git
plugins.description: Git safety plugin: blocks commit/push until user confirms, ships `git-guard-prepare` helper for file-based commit hand-off, enforces commit message format, crystal-completion backup gate, U+FFFD corruption guard on both commit surfaces.

plugins.name: vdm-comms
plugins.description: Meetings and correspondence discipline for repositories that keep them as files: a configurable contract linter for meetings/<date>-<slug>/ and series files (the contract is a floor distilled from three repositories — a track may resolve as a directory or a single file, index.md is owed only after the meeting has happened), a drift signal for the generated registry and per-track meeting pointers, and a PreToolUse guard that refuses to create an outgoing letter already claiming to have been sent. The wording of everything it writes into the project is configurable (comms.labels), defaulting to English. python3 stdlib only — the frontmatter reader is vendored.
